title: Capstone failure testing
outcome: Explain capstone failure testing using the deciding step in this fictional service.
scenario: Inject one component failure. A capstone test blocks model drafting after a successful approved-card retrieval.
given: F4 records club time 15:00. The contract permits a checked fixed-template answer when drafting is unavailable.

steps.label: Verify source
steps.detail: Retrieval supplies F4 and the time 15:00.

steps.label: Inject failure
steps.detail: Disable drafting without changing source evidence.

steps.label: Use bounded fallback
steps.detail: Return the checked template citing F4 and record degraded operation.

explanation: Failure injection changes a component deliberately so the team can inspect the response. A fallback must retain evidence checks and honest status.

counterfactual.prediction: Return unsupported or unavailable; do not use the factual template.
counterfactual.reason: A template can phrase evidence but cannot replace missing evidence.

student_task: Explain why retrieval success permits the checked 15:00 fallback when drafting fails. What changes if retrieval fails too, and why can a template not fill that evidence gap?
teacher_answer: Retrieval supplies F4 and the time 15:00. Disable drafting without changing source evidence. Return the checked template citing F4 and record degraded operation. Changed case: Return unsupported or unavailable; do not use the factual template. A template can phrase evidence but cannot replace missing evidence.
project_evidence: For the Grounded Learning Service, retain an annotated trace and the changed-case result. Name the contract or evidence that makes the deciding step valid, so another team can review it.
limits: This trial covers one failure combination; check other components and interactions separately.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice, distinct from the reserved independent case. These stipulated records illustrate reasoning; no real service execution or learner outcome is claimed.
